Woodward ( (WWD) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On August 19, 2026, Woodward, Inc. entered into a Note Purchase Agreement to privately place $450 million of senior unsecured notes, split evenly among Series U notes due 2029, Series V notes due 2030, and Series W notes due 2033, with coupons starting at 5.34%, 5.39% and 5.64%, respectively, and step-up rates tied to a leverage ratio above 3.5 times. Closing is scheduled for September 30, 2026, with semi-annual interest payments beginning March 30, 2027, and the notes ranking pari passu with other unsecured debt, subject to customary restrictive and financial covenants, guarantees from two wholly owned subsidiaries, standard events of default with a 2% penalty rate increase, and an issuer option to prepay at par plus accrued interest and applicable prepayment compensation.

The agreement’s leverage-based pricing, covenant package and subsidiary guarantees underscore Woodward’s effort to balance funding flexibility with creditor protections and align the new notes with its existing unsecured indebtedness, potentially supporting its liquidity profile and financial discipline over the medium to long term. The prepayment features and cross-currency swap loss coverage also provide structural clarity for investors while allowing Woodward room to manage its capital structure as market conditions evolve.
